issues.description: Attribute 'lectureName' type is inconsistent between the UML in the problem statement and the repository implementation. In problem_statement.md the class diagram declares '-lectureName: int' (line 64), while the solution implementation declares 'private String lectureName;' (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java line 6) and the textual description and toString example treat lectureName as a String. This mismatch can mislead students about the correct type to implement for lectureName.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare lectureName as type String (e.g. '-lectureName: String'). Ensure the textual description, example toString output, and any other references consistently indicate lectureName is a String so students implement the attribute with the correct type.
